staticCallSequence.easy: initial easy map on hook mount, then a second easy map on Start
staticCallSequence.mediumHard: initial easy map, selected-mode setup map on changeDifficulty, then selected-mode map on Start
staticCallSequence.routeSelection: changeDifficulty explicitly sets routeNumber to 1 and generates Route 1
staticCallSequence.laterRoutes: result replay remounts with nextRouteNumber but difficulty resets to easy; selecting medium/hard resets the route to 1
staticCallSequence.rngCoupling: Within one mounted journey, later map identity also depends on Math.random calls consumed by earlier gameplay.
